name: agentdesk
description: A focused desktop client for Codex and Claude Code.

scripts.start: concurrently -k "vite --config src/vite.config.ts --host 127.0.0.1 --port 3000" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:3000 && cross-env ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3000 npm run build:main && electron --user-data-dir=build/dev-profile --remote-debugging-port=9223 ."
scripts.dev:electron: wait-on http://127.0.0.1:3000 && npm run build:main && cross-env ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3000 electron --user-data-dir=build/dev-profile --remote-debugging-port=9223 .
scripts.dev:electron:regression: wait-on http://127.0.0.1:3000 && npm run build:main && cross-env ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3000 electron --user-data-dir=build/electron-regression-profile --remote-debugging-port=9223 .
scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer && npm run test
scripts.test: tsc -p src/tsconfig.test.json && node --test build/tests/main/*.test.js build/tests/main/agent/*.test.js build/tests/main/ipc/*.test.js build/tests/main/providers/codex/*.test.js build/tests/main/providers/claude/*.test.js build/tests/renderer/*.test.js build/tests/renderer/agent/*.test.js
scripts.package: npm run build && cross-env ELECTRON_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron/ ELECTRON_BUILDER_BINARIES_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron-builder-binaries/ electron-builder --win nsis --publish never --config.npmRebuild=false
scripts.release:github: npm run build && cross-env ELECTRON_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron/ ELECTRON_BUILDER_BINARIES_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron-builder-binaries/ electron-builder --win nsis --publish always
scripts.preview: vite build --config src/vite.config.ts --mode browser-preview && vite preview --config src/vite.config.ts --mode browser-preview --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4174
